cvEn:
Born in Jerusalem.

During the First World War, after the armies of Allenby had conquered southern Eretz Israel and Jerusalem from the Turks, Mizrahi volunteered for the Jewish Legion of Eretz Israel, the 40th Battalion of the King's Own Royal Regiment, which was organized in the country as part of the British Army. The aim of the volunteers was to help liberate the land from the Turks. On 26 Tevet 5679 (29 December 1918) he died while performing his duties, and he was laid to rest in the British Military Cemetery in Ramla.
